title: Our Town Photo Is Missing ONE Face 📷
description:
Every year our whole town poses on the bleachers, and the photo only shows people who'll still be in it next year.

Two hundred twelve of us posed. Two hundred eleven faces came out. The gap is right where I sit, and photo day is Saturday at nine.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Was the gap in the photo a warning, or a job offer?
